arangolint: Opinionated best practices for arangodb client
asasalint: Check for pass []any as any in variadic func

bidichk: Checks for dangerous unicode character sequences

canonicalheader: Checks whether net/http.Header uses canonical header
clickhouselint: Opinionated best practices for ClickHouse client

gomoddirectives: Manage the use of replace, retract, and excludes directives in go.mod

gomodguard_v2: Allow and blocklist linter for direct Go module dependencies (updated major version)
